name: Mom’s Multivitamin Gummies (30N)
subtitle: Sustained Energy | Zero Added Sugar | For Women

ingredients.name: Vitamin C
ingredients.shortDesc:
Found in: Oranges, Amla, Strawberry etc.

Form: Ascorbic acid

Amount: 20 mg (53% RDA)

Our nutritionists say: Vitamin C helps wounds heal, boosts the immune system, and keeps infections at bay. Moreover, it is also seen to reduce cholesterol in body.

ingredients.name: Biotin
ingredients.shortDesc:
Found in: Avocados, Nuts, Egg Yolk, Mushrooms etc.

Amount: 40 mcg (87% RDA)

Our nutritionists say: Biotin is the vitamin which helps produce keratin (protein responsible for forming nails, skin and hair). It increases hair growth and even helps promote younger & youthful skin

ingredients.name: Vitamin B12
ingredients.shortDesc:
Found in: Fish, meats, milk, egg yolk etc.

Form: Cyanocobalamin

Amount: 2.2 mcg (50% RDA)

Our nutritionists say: Vitamin B12 is a supermineral. It turns food into energy, which in turn fuels brain development and growth. Most natural B12 is found in animal sources and this is especially good for vegetarians and vegans!

ingredients.name: Vitamin A
ingredients.shortDesc:
Found in: Carrots, Green leafy vegetables and Eggs

Form: Retinyl Palmitate

Amount: 400 mcg

Our nutritionists says: Around here we have a saying: Vitamin A keeps the eye-doctors away! Eyes need this vitamin to heal themselves and reduce weakening of eyes with age.

fullIngredientsList: Chicory Root Inulin (Prebiotic), Gelling Agent (Pectin), Acidity Regulator (Citric Acid), Vitamin C (L-Ascorbic Acid), Natural Flavour (Strawberry), Black Carrot Extract, Vitamin E (D-alpha Tocopherol), Vitamin B5 (Pantothenic Acid), Zinc Citrate, Vitamin B6 (Pyridoxine HCL), Ferrous Fumarate, Vitamin A (Retinyl Palmitate), Vitamin B9 (Dietary Folate), Vitamin B7 (D-Biotin), Potassium Iodide, Vitamin D3 (Cholecalciferol – Vitashine™), Vitamin B12 (Cyanocobalamin SD), Maize Starch, Binding Agent (Guar Gum).

description:
🌸 Energy & Strength, Made Simple for You 

Life demands a lot from you. These Multivitamin Gummies are crafted specially for mothers who are always on the go.A simple, daily ritual to fill nutrient gaps and keep your energy, focus, and mood on track.

Here’s what’s inside
✅ Iron & B12 -  Supports all-day energy & fights fatigue
✅ Vitamin C & D3 -  Immunity & bone support
✅ Biotin - For healthy hair & skin
✅ Chicory Root Fibre -  Gentle on digestion
✅ Zero added sugar • 100% vegan • No preservatives 

Smart Nutrition for Lasting Energy 💛
Made to fuel your strength, support your mood, and help you feel your best, every single day.
Take one gummy daily for 3 months to feel the difference✨
Use 1 gummy daily post any meal.
